title: The Tenure Addition in a Circle Membership Year's Credit
content:
An addition is made to a Northbeam Circle Membership year's credit for how long the profile has held a
Circle membership, counted in months since the membership was taken out, and taken with the lapse day
standing on the record.

## The two additions

1. Where the months since the membership was taken out reach the long tenure months of this schedule, 60
   months, and the membership record carries no lapse day, the long tenure addition of this schedule,
   20.00, is added.
2. Where those months reach the middle tenure months of this schedule, 24 months, but not the long tenure
   months, and the membership record carries no lapse day, the middle tenure addition of this schedule,
   10.00, is added.
3. Where neither of those holds, nothing is added for tenure, and 0.00 goes into the year's credit on this
   account.

## Points of judgement on the tenure bands

*A membership taken out exactly 60 months ago, with no lapse day on the record.* The first band is reached
on the figure itself, so 20.00 is added.

*A membership taken out 59 months ago, with no lapse day.* The months reach 24 but not 60, so the middle
band applies and 10.00 is added.

*A membership taken out 23 months ago.* Neither band is reached and nothing is added.

*A membership taken out 70 months ago whose record carries a lapse day.* Both bands require that the record
carries no lapse day, so nothing is added for tenure however long the membership has run.

| Months since the membership was taken out | Lapse day on the record | Added for tenure |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | None | 20.00 |
| 24 or more but under 60 | None | 10.00 |
| Under 24 | None | 0.00 |
| Any | A lapse day stands | 0.00 |
